name: Gigamander
source:
Gigamander is the artificial version of [url=https://vndb.org/c5280]Salamander[/url], created and mass produced by [url=https://vndb.org/c17591]Promestein[/url].

She imbues her wielder with the power of fire, making their attacks to hit multiple times and be more powerful. [url=https://vndb.org/c5279]Undine's[/url] serene state, which can easily read the movements of an enraged opponent, can guarantee dodging these bloodthirsty attacks. 

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Gigamander]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
